design_notes.venting_vs_topic: CRITICAL DECISION: Venting + topic (e.g., angry about delivery) routes to that topic's intent, NOT to complaint_no_action. complaint_no_action is ONLY for topic-less venting with no identifiable subject matter.
design_notes.rare_intent_oversampling: account_access_issue, complaint_no_action, and prime_membership_inquiry are rare (<3% natural frequency). Golden set will deliberately oversample to ~5-10% each for evaluation coverage.
design_notes.language_scope: English-only. Non-English messages filtered at ingestion (documented limitation).
design_notes.safety_escalation: Crisis/threat/PII/abuse checks happen BEFORE intent classification (mandatory escalation).

intents.description: Customer asking about delivery status, tracking, or when package will arrive. INCLUDES impatient follow-ups even if customer is venting about delay.
intents.disambiguation_rule: Focus on LOCATION/TIMING questions. If message mentions product problem (wrong/damaged item), classify as order_issue instead. Frustrated delivery complaints ('still don't have my order!') belong HERE, not complaint_no_action.
example_utterances: Still unresolved - no clue where the shipment is
Tracking shows delivered but I didn't receive it
Package was supposed to be here yesterday
intents.routing_hints: Auto-handle if tracking info available; escalate if delivery confirmed but customer claims non-receipt.

intents.description: Problem with the product itself: wrong item received, missing items, damaged product, or not as described.
intents.disambiguation_rule: Focus on PRODUCT problems. Pure delivery timing complaints go to delivery_status_inquiry. Prime service complaints (about service level) are NOT product issues.
example_utterances: Received wrong item - ordered blue, got red
This is not what I ordered
intents.routing_hints: Often leads to refund/return. Auto-handle with return label if policy allows; escalate for high-value items.

intents.description: Customer explicitly requesting refund, return, or order cancellation. Must contain explicit ask for money back or to send item back.
intents.disambiguation_rule: MUST have explicit refund/return language. Damaged items without explicit refund request go to order_issue. 'Wet parcel chucked over wall' without 'want refund' = order_issue, not refund_return_request.
example_utterances: I want a refund for order #12345
How do I return this item?
Can I get my money back?
intents.routing_hints: Auto-handle if within return window and policy-compliant; escalate if outside policy or high-value.

intents.description: Issues with charges, payment methods, unauthorized transactions, or billing errors.
intents.disambiguation_rule: Focus on financial transactions. Product issues are NOT payment issues even if customer mentions cost.
intents.routing_hints: Escalate unauthorized charges immediately. Auto-handle payment method updates if customer verified.

intents.description: Login problems, password resets, account locked, or other access issues.
intents.disambiguation_rule: Technical account access issues. NOT order/delivery problems even if customer can't check order status.
example_utterances: Can't log in to my account
intents.routing_hints: Auto-handle password resets. Escalate suspected account compromise.
intents.note: RARE INTENT (~1-3% natural frequency) - oversample to ~5-10% for golden set evaluation coverage.

intents.description: Questions about Prime membership, subscription, benefits, or cancellation. Must explicitly mention Prime SUBSCRIPTION/MEMBERSHIP context, not just Prime service quality.
intents.disambiguation_rule: Must mention Prime subscription/membership/trial/benefits. 'I am a Prime member but not getting prime service' is a SERVICE COMPLAINT (delivery_status_inquiry or general_inquiry), NOT a membership question.
example_utterances: How do I cancel Prime membership?
Prime trial ending - how to continue?
intents.routing_hints: Auto-handle benefit inquiries. Escalate cancellation requests (retention).
intents.note: RARE INTENT (~2-4% natural frequency) - oversample to ~5-10% for golden set.

intents.description: General questions or requests that don't fit other specific categories. Must have explicit question marker (how/what/why/can you) OR concrete action request (please help/need to). NOT frustration + topic (those route to topic intent).
intents.disambiguation_rule: Only if no other intent applies AND has clear question/request. 'Angry about delivery' = delivery_status_inquiry, NOT general_inquiry. This is for truly miscellaneous questions.
example_utterances: How do I update my address?
Can you help me find an item?
intents.routing_hints: Auto-handle FAQ-style questions. Escalate complex policy questions.

intents.description: Pure frustration/venting with NO identifiable subject matter or actionable request. TOPIC-LESS ONLY: 'Pathetic services!!!' has no topic. 'Still don't have my books!' HAS a topic (delivery) and belongs in delivery_status_inquiry.
intents.disambiguation_rule: CRITICAL: This is ONLY for messages with NO identifiable topic. If venting mentions delivery/order/refund/payment/account, route to THAT intent, NOT here. This category is for 'NOTHING YET. WOW' or 'Terrible service!!!' with zero context.
intents.routing_note: STRONG ESCALATION CANDIDATE - no concrete resolution path without follow-up.
intents.note: RARE INTENT (~1-2% natural frequency under corrected definition) - oversample to ~5-10% for golden set.
intents.design_decision: Venting + topic (e.g., angry delivery complaint) routes to that topic's intent. This intent is ONLY for venting WITHOUT identifiable subject matter. Prevents systematic mis-escalation of frustrated but actionable requests.

evaluation_stratification.rationale: Oversample rare intents for per-class F1 measurement. Natural distribution would give insufficient rare-intent examples for meaningful evaluation.
